typography.instructions: Mix Chinese characters (Noto Sans SC) and Korean meanings (Noto Sans KR) seamlessly. Ensure Chinese characters are scaled slightly larger (e.g., text-5xl to text-7xl for flashcards) for stroke visibility, especially when using HanziWriter.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard with generous padding (p-6, p-8) for cards.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid for dashboard. Mobile-first single column, expanding to 3 or 4 columns on desktop.
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Playful Neo-brutalist / Push-button. border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_4px_0_rgb(226,232,240)]. Active state: translate-y-1 shadow-none.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align for reading text, Center-align for flashcards and quiz inputs.
layout_and_spacing.slot_management: Use grid layout for the 10 slots. 3 free slots distinctly styled. Slots 4-10 styled as locked with premium visual cues and 'Watch Ad' CTA.

components.buttons: Rounded-xl, bold text, solid bottom shadow for a tactile 'pressable' feel. Primary uses brand color, secondary uses slate-100.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav with crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200). Avatar and streak prominently displayed.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog customized with rounded-2xl, centered content. High-impact warnings for 'Insufficient Slots'.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs customized as segmented controls. Pill-shaped triggers, distinct colors for Word (Blue) vs Sentence (Purple) when active.
components.toast: Sonner with rich colors (Green for correct/success, Red for incorrect/error).
components.progress_bar: Thick rounded-full bars with animated width.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow.
motion_and_interaction.click: Buttons press down (translate-y-1, shadow goes to 0).
motion_and_interaction.gamification: Micro-animations on correct answers (e.g., subtle scale bounce), countdown timer pulse for expiring slots.

images.description: Vibrant abstract shapes for login or dashboard header background overlay.
3D gold coins used as an illustrative element for unlocking premium slots or watching ads.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance, particularly for white text on Word/Sentence brand colors.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='slot-unlock-btn', data-testid='quiz-option').

instructions_to_main_agent: Migrate the single HTML logic to modular React components (.js files).
Implement Google Login and persist user profile (nickname, avatar, stats) in state/storage.
Build the dashboard emphasizing gamification: streaks, progress bars, and the Slot Management system.
Slot System Logic: Users have slots 1-3 unlocked by default. Slots 4-10 require 'watching an ad' (mocked via button click) to unlock for 60 days. Show countdowns on unlocked premium slots.
Import Logic: When importing data, verify if the required slots exceed currently available (unlocked) slots. If so, abort and show a warning modal.
Integrate HanziWriter for Hanzi stroke animations on the flashcard/writing quiz views.
Color Theme Enforcement: Enforce Blue (#2563EB) for Word Learning contexts, and Purple (#7E22CE) for Sentence Learning contexts.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography to match the gamified aesthetic.
Apply tactile 'push-button' CSS styles (border + bottom box-shadow) to major CTAs and quiz option cards.
